name: Carnth
description: Carnth was a Mid Rim world located in the M'shinni sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire's prefect on Carnth promised the farmers of a local village substantial rewards for remaining loyal to the Empire, which hampered the Rebel Alliance's efforts to establish a small base at the settlement. Eventually, Airen Cracken led a Rebel force in an assault on the village that ultimately resulted in the settlement aligning itself with the Alliance.
